For this model, the project team analyzed nighttime crashes after midnight after the lighting systems were converted to LED. The model (Table 20) was developed for C1 roadways (major HPMS roadways) in Cambridge and HPMS roadways in Somerville. As the table shows, after midnight and for the major roadways in the two cities, the city indicator variable in the model had a parameter of 0.9 (with a p-value < 0.001), indicating that the dimmed light levels correlated with a higher nighttime crash frequency compared to Somerville.
